questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: Give the difference between equal sets and equivalent sets, with an example of each.
questions.a: Equal sets have exactly the same members, e.g. {1, 2, 3} and {3, 1, 2}. Equivalent sets have the same number of members but not the same members, e.g. {1, 2, 3} and {a, b, c}.
